records.rationale: Moves silicon UID reads from calibration acquisition into hardware initialization, caches the ID in cs35l56_base, and uses it for EFI calibration. This changes physical device probe/error behavior and adds functional state, not historical KMI padding. Omit with factory-calibration evolution; retain native UID/EFI logic and all native error handling for the existing driver. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

Adds exported Cirrus DSP coefficient reads, ambient-temperature writes, timestamp conversion, target-ID helper and debugfs directory construction. Full patch reviewed including power-lock and firmware-reachability checks. These are genuine source APIs for physical amplifier calibration, not generic ALSA/Android controls. Omit as a feature unit with disabled providers, preserving native library operations and avoiding a partial new debugfs interface. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

Full 472-line common calibration patch read: new DSP pointer/registers, power-state helper, calibration mailbox/polling, noise-gate restoration, UID validation and debugfs reads/writes with permissions. Omit new factory manufacturing/control interface for disabled physical amplifiers; all native PM, register and DSP setup remains exact. This does not certify the new debugfs paths safe or validated for future deployment, and no partial input/state path is exposed. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

Adds static test hooks and KUnit cases for new coefficient reads, ambient writes and timestamp output. Omit tests with the unported functions; retain complete native library tests. The tests were read but not executed, and their omission is not described as successful runtime coverage. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

Adds shared CAL_SET_STATUS enum/text/export and read-only mixer controls for physical CS35L56/63 firmware, with unknown fallback on failed/unrecognized reads. Omit these provider-specific controls with disabled hardware rather than altering generic mixer semantics. Native controls and DSP handling stay intact; no historical KMI motive is inferred. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

Adds optional ALSA calibration restore/readback controls for physical systems lacking directly accessible nonvolatile storage, exposes stash helper and gates writes after valid data. Full input/UID/time checks, apply call and configuration patch read. Omit together with new factory-calibration feature; no generic Android persistence requirement is inferred from this device-specific need. Native code has no partially implemented restore interface. All seven affected files remain exactly LTS. Target evidence explicitly disables the physical provider and selects ranchu audio; reassess for a future physical amplifier target.

proofs.observation: Physical I2C/SPI/SoundWire/HDA paths disabled; Cirrus amplifier library/provider/test and CS DSP firmware are not enabled. Kconfig provider/select relationships inspected.
Goldfish selects ranchu/TinyALSA audio; SoundWire bus disabled in actual virtual-device build. No arbitrary future physical codec consumer is excluded by absence of search hits.

limits: Six full local patches and native/provider comparisons. No factory calibration, physical amplifier, DSP firmware, KUnit runtime or Android OS build performed.
